File metadata

Source: R/meta.R
meta.Rd

meta() gets and sets the metadata attached to a vector or data frame by read_sas(), read_spss(), or read_stata(). The metadata is stored in a single haven_meta attribute holding an S7 object whose class depends on the vendor and on whether x is a data frame:

  • Column metadata: meta_var_sas, meta_var_spss, meta_var_stata.

  • Data frame metadata: meta_df_sas, meta_df_spss, meta_df_stata.

If no metadata has been set, meta() falls back to the legacy format.*, display_width, width, notes, and *_timestamp attributes, so objects saved by older versions of haven keep working.

Usage

meta(x, vendor = NULL)

meta(x, vendor = NULL) <- value

Arguments

x

A vector or data frame.

vendor

If supplied, one of "sas", "spss", or "stata". Returns an empty object of the appropriate class if no metadata is present, and errors if the existing metadata belongs to another vendor.

value

NULL or a metadata object of the appropriate class. Setting metadata (including NULL) also removes the legacy attributes, so they can't resurface later.

Value

meta() returns an S7 object inheriting from meta_var (for vectors) or meta_df (for data frames), or NULL.

Examples

df <- read_sav(system.file("examples", "iris.sav", package = "haven"))

# Data frame metadata
meta(df)
#> <haven::meta_df_spss>
#> @created : 2016-06-10 11:25:39 UTC
#> @modified: 2016-06-10 11:25:39 UTC
meta(df)@created
#> [1] "2016-06-10 11:25:39 UTC"

# Column metadata
meta(df$Species)
#> <haven::meta_var_spss>
#> @format       : "F8.0"
#> @display_width: 8
#> @measure      : "nominal"
#> @alignment    : "right"
meta(df$Species)@format
#> [1] "F8.0"

# Modify metadata
meta(df$Species)@measure <- "ordinal"
meta(df$Species)
#> <haven::meta_var_spss>
#> @format       : "F8.0"
#> @display_width: 8
#> @measure      : "ordinal"
#> @alignment    : "right"
